heuristics: H1 coverage: the 6N^2(1 - 1/L) distinct rationals a w/(u a' w') hit z nearly like independent uniform elements of H: at production size |R|/m >= 1 - e^-K - 0.0005, a coverage within the census deviation (1 - e^-K = 0.390508 rounded down at K = 0.49513; success at least 0.390007 after every failure term and this allowance). z is uniform in H and independent of the lists, so P(z is an off-diagonal candidate) = |R|/m exactly, R the mu6 multiples of the off-diagonal ratios.
